title: System
lead: Language, startup, power actions, power profiles, memory, music and Windows shortcuts.

exit.confirmToTray: Close the dashboard to the system tray? PlayOut keeps running there.
exit.confirmToDesktop: Close the dashboard and return to the Windows desktop?

language.title: Language
language.label: Language
language.description: PlayOut's menus and messages. Game names and details stay as their stores and sources write them.

launchAtLogin.label: Launch at login
launchAtLogin.description: Start PlayOut when you sign in to Windows.

minimizeToTray.label: Minimize to tray
minimizeToTray.description: Closing PlayOut keeps it running in the system tray. Quit from the tray icon's menu.

confirmPowerActions.label: Confirm power actions
confirmPowerActions.description: Ask before sleeping, restarting, shutting down or exiting.

enhancedSleepWake.label: Enhanced Sleep/Wake
enhancedSleepWake.description: Freezes the running game while the PC sleeps or the screen is locked, and resumes it when you're back. Sleep pauses background apps and the network, nothing but you wakes the PC, and it hibernates after 48 hours of sleep to save the battery (one administrator step; undone when turned off).

controllerWake.label: Wake with the Xbox button
controllerWake.description: Pressing the Xbox button on an Xbox controller wakes the PC from sleep. Needs the Xbox Wireless Adapter or a USB cable (Bluetooth usually cannot wake a PC), and a PC whose sleep lets USB devices wake it. One administrator step; undone when turned off.

power.title: Power profiles
power.noteDynamic: Switch from the overlay (the home button). Dynamic TDP (the default) raises or lowers the watts during a game to hold your target frame rate; Custom watts sets fixed limits.
power.noteStatic: Switch profiles from the overlay (the home button). Each profile sets the Windows power mode, the CPU maximum and CPU boost, and with the power helper, watts.

defaultProfile.label: Outside games
defaultProfile.description: Used when no game runs, and for games without their own profile.

targetFps.label: Dynamic TDP target
targetFps.description: The frame rate Dynamic TDP holds in games without their own target.

dynamicMin.label: Dynamic TDP lowest watts
dynamicMin.description: Never below this, even when the target is easy to reach.

dynamicMax.label: Dynamic TDP highest watts
dynamicMax.description: Never above this, even when the target is not reached (cooler and quieter).

perGame.label: Per-game profiles
perGame.description: Switch to a game's own profile while it runs, and back afterwards.

useWatts.label: Set watts
useWatts.description: Use the power helper's sustained and boost limits when it is installed.

helper.label: Power helper
helper.installFailed: Could not install the power helper
helper.removeFailed: Could not remove the power helper

memory.title: Memory
memory.label: Free up memory while PlayOut is running
memory.description: Trims background apps when a game starts and when memory runs low. Temporary: Windows refills its cache, and apps you switch back to may be slow for a moment.

pass.nothing: Nothing could be freed this time

result.idle: Runs one cleanup now. PlayOut, your game and the app in front are never touched.

tier.missing: Only your own apps are trimmed. System-wide cleanup needs the power helper: install it from the Power helper row above.
tier.outdated: Only your own apps are trimmed. System-wide cleanup needs the newer power helper: press Install or Update in the Power helper row above.
tier.notAnswering: Only your own apps are trimmed. The power helper is not answering: remove it and install it again from the Power helper row above.
tier.unavailable: Only your own apps are trimmed: system-wide cleanup needs the power helper, which is not available on this PC.

music.title: Music

folder.label: Music folder
folder.description: Music files (mp3, m4a, aac, flac, ogg, opus, wav) the overlay can play over any game.
folder.chooseFailed: Could not choose the music folder

gameStart.label: When a game starts
gameStart.description: Games get their own playlists in the overlay's Music tab.

music.note: Music plays from the overlay's player: open it with the home button to see what is playing.

windows.title: Windows settings
windows.note: Opens the matching page of the Windows Settings app.

controllerWake.offDeclined: Turning wake off needs administrator approval, which was declined. Turn the switch on and off again to ask again.
controllerWake.offFailed: Windows did not turn wake off. Turn the switch on and off again to try again, or untick "Allow this device to wake the computer" in Device Manager.
controllerWake.offFailedFor: Windows did not turn wake off for {devices}. Turn the switch on and off again to try again, or untick "Allow this device to wake the computer" in Device Manager.
controllerWake.unreadable: The wake settings could not be read from Windows.
controllerWake.declined: Administrator approval was declined. Turn the switch off and on again to ask again.
controllerWake.refused: Windows did not allow {refused}. In Device Manager, open it, Power Management, and tick "Allow this device to wake the computer"; or turn the switch off and on again to try again.
controllerWake.refusedBeside: Wakes the PC: {wakes}. Windows did not allow {refused}. In Device Manager, open it, Power Management, and tick "Allow this device to wake the computer"; or turn the switch off and on again to try again.
controllerWake.locked: Windows lists {devices} as able to wake the PC but does not let its setting be changed. Check that the Xbox accessories driver is installed.
controllerWake.adapterCannotWake: The Xbox Wireless Adapter is plugged in, but Windows does not list it as able to wake this PC. Check that its driver is installed, and that sleep in the BIOS allows USB wake (S3).
controllerWake.noDevice: No Xbox Wireless Adapter or wired Xbox controller that can wake this PC was found. Plug one in; it is set up at the next start, or when the switch is turned on again.
